description: This file defines configuration options and validation logic for the Activation Repartitioner component in Orleans, including properties for edge count, round periods, recovery periods, and filtering options, along with a validator class to enforce constraints.

classes.name: ActivationRepartitionerOptions
classes.description: A sealed class encapsulating configuration settings for the activation repartitioner, including parameters for edge count, timing, recovery, buffering, filtering, and error rate.

classes.name: ActivationRepartitionerOptionsValidator
classes.description: An internal sealed class implementing configuration validation logic for ActivationRepartitionerOptions, ensuring property values meet specified constraints.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the configuration properties of ActivationRepartitionerOptions, throwing exceptions if constraints are violated.

methods.name: ThrowMustBeGreaterThanZero
methods.description: Helper method to throw an exception if a property is not greater than zero.

methods.name: ThrowMustBeGreaterThanOrEqualToZero
methods.description: Helper method to throw an exception if a property is less than zero.

methods.name: ThrowMustBeGreaterThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Helper method to throw an exception if one property is not greater than or equal to another property.
